thesis: Equal permission conceals different options and capacities to help; freedom and responsibility arise among vulnerable interdependent beings.

ideas.statement: Protect freedom against others’ power while allocating responsibility for actions, institutions and omissions that shape shared destinies.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The opening scene is hypothetical; real conflicts between obligation and liberty cannot be resolved by renaming all benevolent constraints freedom.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: The opening scene is hypothetical; real conflicts between obligation and liberty cannot be resolved by renaming all benevolent constraints freedom.
